lines.text: Terah saal. GTA 5 se GTA 6 tak, sab kuch badal gaya hai.
Pehla farq: shehar. GTA 5 mein tha Los Santos,
aur GTA 6 mein wapas aa raha hai Vice City, Leonida state mein.
Doosra: map. Reports ke mutabik naya map lagbhag do guna bada hai.
Teesra: hero. GTA 5 mein teen the, Michael, Franklin aur Trevor.
GTA 6 mein do hain, Lucia aur Jason, ek jodi.
Chautha: console. GTA 5 PS3 par aaya tha, aur aaj PC par bhi hai.
GTA 6 sirf PS5 aur Xbox Series par aayega, PC ki koi date nahi.
Aur GTA 5 ki teis crore se zyada copies bik chuki hain.
GTA 6 aa raha hai unnees November ko.
Ab Part 2 aap chuno: A, Leonida ka poora map, ya B, Lucia aur Jason ki kahani.
Comment mein A ya B likho.
